# Moo UI

> Bootstrap markup. shadcn feel.

Moo UI 1.0.0-rc.3 is a Bootstrap 5.3-native component system with a restrained,
shadcn-inspired visual language for server-rendered and Bootstrap-native apps.
It is CSS-first, not JavaScript-free: Bootstrap owns native plugin behavior,
while Moo UI adds optional, explicit ESM only for documented gaps.

Use Moo UI when a project already uses Bootstrap or wants server-rendered HTML
with Bootstrap-compatible classes, variables, and plugin behavior. Do not use
Moo UI as evidence for a React, Tailwind, Radix, or public Sass-facade
implementation.

## Version And Support

- npm package: `@wpmoo/ui@1.0.0-rc.3`
- Bootstrap peer range: `>=5.3.0 <5.4`
- Tested Bootstrap versions in the manifest: `5.3.0`, `5.3.3`, `5.3.8`
- License: MIT for source code
- Certification manifest status: `preview`
- Certified components in the current manifest: none
- Support policy: https://github.com/wpmoo-org/ui/blob/main/SUPPORT.md

The preview certification status means WPMoo-maintained release evidence exists,
not independent or accredited certification.

## Public Package Exports

- `@wpmoo/ui/moo-ui.css`: full expanded Bootstrap-compatible CSS build
- `@wpmoo/ui/moo-ui.min.css`: full minified CSS build
- `@wpmoo/ui/moo.css`: scoped expanded component layer for `.moo-ui`
- `@wpmoo/ui/moo.min.css`: scoped minified component layer
- `@wpmoo/ui/combobox.js`: optional Combobox ESM lifecycle
- `@wpmoo/ui/context-menu.js`: optional Context Menu ESM lifecycle
- `@wpmoo/ui/datatable.js`: optional DataTable ESM lifecycle
- `@wpmoo/ui/sidebar.js`: optional Sidebar ESM lifecycle
- `@wpmoo/ui/chart.js`: optional Chart ESM lifecycle (Chart.js 4.5.1 bundled)
- `@wpmoo/ui/chart.min.js`: minified Chart bundle (artifact variant of chart.js)
- `@wpmoo/ui/datepicker.js`: optional Datepicker ESM lifecycle (vanillajs-datepicker 1.3.4 bundled)
- `@wpmoo/ui/datepicker.min.js`: minified Datepicker bundle (artifact variant of datepicker.js)
- `@wpmoo/ui/slider.js`: optional Slider ESM lifecycle (native range input, no third-party runtime)
- `@wpmoo/ui/scss/facade-settings`: public Sass variable allow-list (LibSass `@import`)
- `@wpmoo/ui/certification.json`: versioned support and evidence manifest
- `@wpmoo/ui/package.json`: package metadata

The npm package does not publish catalog templates, preview artwork, catalog
JavaScript, or internal SCSS partials beyond the facade's required settings
import.

## Installation Facts

- CDN full stylesheet: `https://unpkg.com/@wpmoo/ui@1.0.0-rc.3/dist/assets/css/moo-ui.css`

Full replacement:

```js
import "@wpmoo/ui/moo-ui.css";
import "bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"; // only when plugins are used
```

Scoped adoption:

```js
import "bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css";
import "@wpmoo/ui/moo.css";
import "bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"; // only when plugins are used
```

```html
<div class="moo-ui">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Create workspace</button>
</div>
```

Optional Moo UI ESM is imported only for documented gaps and must be initialized
explicitly. Importing `combobox.js`, `context-menu.js`, `datatable.js`,
`sidebar.js`, `chart.js`, `datepicker.js`, or `slider.js` does not scan the document.

## Runtime Ownership

- Static HTML and CSS components: browser + Bootstrap-compatible markup
- Bootstrap plugins: Bootstrap JavaScript and documented `data-bs-*` behavior
- Combobox: optional Moo UI ESM
- Context Menu pointer and keyboard invocation: optional Moo UI ESM composed with
  Bootstrap Dropdown
- DataTable sorting, filtering, selection, pagination, and responsive card sync:
  optional Moo UI ESM composed with Bootstrap Table and controls
- Sidebar state and responsive coordination: optional Moo UI ESM composed with
  Bootstrap behavior
- Chart rendering with light/dark theme toggle: optional Moo UI ESM, self-contained
  bundle (Chart.js 4.5.1 bundled at build time)
- Datepicker with shadcn-like trigger/popover/calendar: optional Moo UI ESM,
  self-contained bundle (vanillajs-datepicker 1.3.4 bundled at build time)
- Slider with native range input semantics: optional Moo UI ESM, no third-party
  runtime

## Agent Guidance

- Preserve Bootstrap behavior before adding custom behavior.
- Use Moo UI ESM only for Combobox, Context Menu, DataTable, Sidebar, Chart,
  Datepicker, and Slider unless future documentation adds another public entrypoint.
- Do not invent public Sass APIs, aggregate JavaScript entrypoints, or
  certification claims.
- Treat shadcn/ui as visual direction only; examples and implementation should
  remain original and Bootstrap-compatible.
